provenance: Independent read-only parser of original PE bytes; not a new REA Evidence record
format: MSVC x64 image-relative RTTI with signature1 and exact self RVA
limitations: COL identity and hierarchy structures are directly parsed from file bytes. Vftable trailing length uses contiguous pointers into executable source ranges and is a heuristic.
Base descriptors include the most-derived class and possibly repeated virtual bases; baseCount is not a direct-base count.
Member displacement describes an inherited subobject, not a full class size or complete member layout.
Original function names/signatures, nonvirtual members and missing RTTI remain unknown. No binary or analysis database was changed.
